product_overview: Petralib Constructor is a Spring Boot and React based web application designed for building and managing workflows using a block constructor interface. It supports project and service management, data types definition, scenario configuration, and secure user authentication.
core_goals: Enable users to authenticate securely via JWT and manage user roles and permissions
Provide comprehensive project management with CRUD operations and user-specific views
Support creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of various block types (workflow, action, source) with variables management
Allow management of custom data types and fields with inheritance capabilities
Facilitate service management including service configuration, listing, and export
Enable detailed workflow scenario creation, variable management, and execution
Ensure API security with Spring Security and support role-based and project-level authorization
Provide robust pagination and filtering for lists of projects, blocks, types, and services
Offer full API validation and error handling with meaningful HTTP status codes
Maintain comprehensive testing coverage especially for REST API endpoints using JUnit and Mockito
key_features: User authentication and authorization with JWT tokens and role-based access control
Project management module supporting creation, update, retrieval, and deletion of user projects
Block management system for workflows, actions, and sources with pagination and filtering by name and project
Type management allowing custom data type definitions, including fields and inheritance, with conflict detection
Service management with configuration, retrieval, deletion, and JSON export capabilities
Scenario management for defining workflow execution logic, managing scenario blocks and variables
REST API design following MVC architecture with layered backend (Controller, Service, Repository)
Frontend implemented in React + Redux with SASS styling for interactive workflow construction
Secure endpoints requiring JWT Bearer tokens except for login
Well-documented API with detailed request/response models and error codes
user_flow_summary: User logs in using email and password to receive a JWT token for authenticated requests
User creates or selects a project from their accessible projects list
Within a project, user manages blocks (workflow, action, source) by creating, viewing, updating, or deleting them
User defines and manages custom data types and their fields to support block variable types
User manages services related to their projects, including creating new services and exporting configuration files
User constructs workflow scenarios by arranging scenario blocks, setting variables, and defining execution flows
User logs out to invalidate current authentication token and end session
validation_criteria: All API endpoints except login require a valid JWT token in 'Authorization' header
Project names must be unique per user with a maximum length of 100 characters
Block creation and updates require valid type and correctly defined variables with appropriate multiplicity and types
Type definitions must not conflict and must validate field names and inheritance rules
Service configurations must include required fields (name, path, projectId) and pass validation
Scenario variables and blocks must be properly linked and validated for consistency
Pagination parameters must be correctly handled to return accurate page counts and elements
Error responses must return appropriate HTTP status codes such as 400 for validation errors, 403 for authorization failures, and 406 for type conflicts
REST API tests achieve 100% coverage for API endpoints with partial unit test coverage, ensuring stability
JWT tokens expiration and renewal mechanisms must be enforced to maintain security
